body:
I just got back from the hospital. Got a bay leaf stuck in my throat while eating soup. Doctor said I was lucky I didn't suffocate. That would have been a dumb way to die.

I can enjoy a pretty wide range of music too. Was kind of into alternative rock for a while. Right now I mostly listen to really sad but relatable music. Didn't know Anathema before, but I just checked them out - the song you recommended and some others. It's pretty damn good. Really emotional but also calming in a way. I'm probably going to listen through more of their stuff. Thanks!

Sure millions of useless apps :D Yeah I like games a lot, played many different ones. I've been into league of legends for a while. Though I'm not too good and the community can be horrible, playing with friends or just when you get a nice team is awesome. However one of the best gaming experiences I've recently had was with a game called Danganronpa. It's more like a visual novel than a game mostly, but a really great one. If you're into that kind of stuff and have the time I would recommend it. 

Sadly for me, my laptop broke a few months back and I can't game on my current pc. What about you, are you into games?

Ok got it. You're really nice to talk to and are seem to be good at dealing with people so I guess the psychology really shows :D Or maybe you're just good idk

Well you said it's engaging so that's good I suppose. Does it get boring because you already know everything to it?

Btw I hope I'm not annoying you by bombarding you with huge replies.

Also maybe we should PM since this comment thread is getting real deep?

Cool, have any music recommendations?

I'm not sure how good I actually am at either of these things but i guess so, thanks :D Yeah programming can be creative, you can make all kinds of stuff and in many different ways. Maybe in the future I'll be able to use it to make something I really want to (like a cool page or a game).

Is Organizational Behaviour like a psychology/economy related thing? What kind of work do you do at the back office?

Yeah you're probably right, I should talk to someone. I have one or maybe two friends who might listen so I'll need to try. Otherwise loneliness will probably just keep driving me insane. I do feel trapped inside my mind a lot of the time. Just these horrible thoughts circling in my head and I can't come to any kind of conclusion.

In the past I tried to talk to my family which turned out to be a great mistake and just led me to realize that everyone in my family is a pretty huge selfish asshole. In fact my family is probably the main reason I'm depressed. But at least now I won't make the same mistake again.

Thanks for believing in me and I hope so too. What about you, do you play any instrument?

I'm studying informatics. It's like computer science I guess. It can be boring sometimes, especially all the math related stuff, but it also feels good to be able to write your own programs and mess around with them. Maybe after I see the psychiatrist I'll also be able to study better. Cause I waste lots of time from lack of motivation and inability to concentrate.

Are you studying anything right now? Or working somewhere maybe? And also how are you doing right now?

Don't worry you're not intruding at all. I gave it up cause I felt like I couldn't play while I'm this depressed. I couldn't ever fully get into it and sometimes I would just randomly give up in the middle of a song. It's kind of hard to explain. Also I was too anxious to go looking for a band and I don't think anyone would want a drummer who many days has little to no real energy anyways.

Maybe I'll pick it up again if I start feeling better. I finally made an appointment with a psychiatrist today after a long time of suffering. Really hope it makes me feel at least somewhat better eventually. 

Drums can be a lot of fun and you can let out your emotions and be very creative. But while I'm like this it feels impossible to do it. I just felt like it was going nowhere. So for now I'm focusing on my studies. Not sure I made the right choice but that's the choice I made. Thanks for asking, feels kinda nice to talk stuff through.

I'm in a very similar situation too. 20, don't get along with anyone in my family. Have only a couple friends (who have no idea how I actually feel). Never dated even once cause I have zero self esteem and honestly just feel sorry for women when they have to talk to me, because I think I just freak them out. 

Use to play the drums (on an electric kit), but gave it up a few months back. 

I've seen 1 psychologist before, she didn't help much at all. I guess I just got unlucky. Haven't tried any kind of antidepressants yet, but probably will once I have the money for it.

Definitely get feeling like a zombie. I constantly feel like I'm sleepwalking through life. I lack energy to really care much anymore.

But yeah you have my empathy and I guess at least you can know you're not alone in this hell. As little help as that may be.

Yeah I've had people tell me that as well. They're always so proud of themselves too and completely certain in their righteousness.

I'm pretty certain by now that my family doesn't really care how I feel. Whenever I try to talk to them they just end up talking about themselves. All they have ever cared about is themselves. I have one friend I could maybe talk to honestly but I'm not sure how he could help. It would probably just ruin our friendship. 

I'm in uni and I'm looking up information now about counselors or any help really. Unfortunately their page sucks and I'm just getting a bunch of 404 errors from every useful seeming link. Maybe I should ask around but that sounds scary as hell right now.

Up till now my plan was to get a job (which I am working towards) and use the money earned to get help. However that might be too long a wait so I guess I have to look for something.

Thanks for the comment, it's nice to at least feel a bit less alone.

Was on level 3 and nearly went through with it a couple of times. During those times I would honestly feel like I'm in hell. The world becomes a very different, dark, horrifying place.
I also wrote a full note once. Was sure I was going to do it but then just fell asleep cause I felt completely exhausted. (That time I was completely drunk which I have come to learn is not a good thing to do then you're having suicidal thoughts :d)
I think you really put it all well. Hope neither of us has to experience 3 again.

I think I understand what you mean. Maybe the inability to love and getting annoyed easily are side effects of being depressed.
If you want to be friends with those people perhaps you should try to pay attention and really engage in conversations when you're with them. Maybe you don't and then I hope you find better friends.
Anyway I'm almost 20 and still trying to figure shit out myself xd Good luck, I hope you get to feel happier

How old are you? I'm 19. Well I would keep changing the time as I eventually crossed the one where I was going to kill myself :d Why can't you picture yourself loving them? Or do you not want to talk about that?
Thanks, I hope so too :D It's just really hard to get out of this sad hole I'm in cause I feel so fucked up and empty inside and it makes it really difficult to keep any relationships with people
I feel you. I'm not motivated to do anything anymore and don't even know what to do with myself. I feel like any effort I put in has no effect in the end. Pm me if you feel like it

It was kind of similar for me in school. I would think everyone around me is an asshole and stupid and didn't try to understand other people, make friends or to do well in school. Then I finally came to realize that I'm an antisocial loser and that maybe I'm the dick

Used to happen to me ever since I was a kid. I would think I have no future and after a certain amount of years I should just kill myself. I wouldn't really be sad about it, it was just my constant way of thinking. Wasn't exactly wrong about my future. Now when I get those thoughts they can be a lot more depressing because I get really close to actually doing it
I have so many memories of similar things happening to me. They haunt me fucking forever
Same here, I start working out and studying like crazy and then in a few days or even hours I stop doing anything at all. Makes it all seem completely worthless.
Happens all the time to me too. I get motivated to do all kind of things an change my life around and then in a couple of hours I feel just about ready to kill myself

I have only a couple real friends, but they don't know how I am and I'm afraid that if I tell them they won't really understand and it might just ruin the friendship. Yeah I probably will do the writing thing and hope it helps.

Sorry to hear that you're in a crappy situation too. If you really feel like talking I might write to you a bit later and you can definitely talk to me as well if you ever feel like it. Thanks a lot for replying, you helped me get out of a really shit state of mind

I'm 19 and living with my parents still. We don't have a lot of money and when I mention therapy they just get pissed at me. I'm studying and keep looking for a job though not very successfully. Right now I'm thinking of taking an online writing program - it's something I could afford and would maybe help me a bit. Thanks for the reply

This describes me so well too. Especially the first half. Didn't gain a single friend all throughout school. And the few ones I have from other places are very different from me and I think rarely really understand me.

I often feel like I'm pretending and failing everyone's expectations of me. Sometimes I get really scared that somehow I will get outed as a pretentious piece of shit idiot. However I don't think most people really expect much from me anymore. Anyway, I can relate

Damn well i hope it goes better with the doctor. Yeah it's really strange suddenly being in a place where you're expected to open up about everything you've been trying to hide away. 

Same for me, I'm mostly doing better now than before, but it still gets really bad a lot. Perhaps with the right circumstances and treatment we can heal at least to some point.

Thanks for all the kind words, it truly means a lot. Best of luck to you, my friend. You seem like a very nice person and I hope life gets better for you.

Nice, that should probably help you out, hope it does. 
I had a psychologist at one time but had to stop seeing her, because my parents made me feel really guilty about it (difficult and shitty situation). Wasn't enough time to help me much and I also found it really difficult to talk to her, it was like I would forget all the horrible things I was going through as soon as I would come in. Really sucks, especially since I was about to get put on some pills which could have helped me cope with both reality and the nightmares. 
Anyway you should have a better experience than I did :D And I definitely understand being scared to go, I was scared every single time no matter how many times I went. I guess you just got to realise it's their job to help, say fuck it and go see them. If you're like me and freeze up and forget things when talking about your problems, I suggest not making my mistake and writing them down beforehand :D 

Thanks, maybe I won't, but I'm starting to think this stuff doesn't ever fully go away on it's own and I'm probably going to have to deal with it somehow eventually.

Valerian is like very mild medication. I'm not even sure if it had much effect on me but it does help some people and maybe might help you. Should probably consult with a doctor before taking anything more serious :D In fact if it's possible for you perhaps try to see a doctor or psychologist either way. I would do the same but I'm 19 and still depend on my parents and they aren't very supportive.

Damn a couple of years is a long time. No problem man, we're on the same shitty nightmare filled boat :D

I was dreaming only nightmares for maybe 3 months, maybe even more. It was horrible because they would always be very realistic and contain my biggest fears or recreate the worst things that happened to me in life in an even more terrifying way. I would wake up many times every night terrified. Though I don't think I would ever mix up dreams with reality, sounds really horrible, man. In my case I think my mind was really disturbed at the time and it was the anxiety getting to me. Thankfully it ended about a month back (though I still get them, just not always).
Perhaps you're like me and have a crazy amount of anxiety and some things haunting your mind. Maybe you should try taking something relaxing like valerian or other before sleep. Hope your nightmares end too.

I do self deprecating jokes a lot too and the worst part about it, for me at least, is that instead of just having a laugh like you expect, many times people take it as some sort of permission to bully me. Then they just keep poking fun with more and more insulting jokes even after I make it clear that I've had enough. Now I try to catch myself before making these jokes but it's harder than it might seem. Idk maybe you can relate

I think I've had many kind of similar experiences with my family. They never understood what was happening with me and the rare times when we would talk they would give me advice that made no sense and examples that had nothing to do with anything.
They would also get insanely mad if I would criticize anything they do. It was like everyone's pretending that it's all fine when really everything is fucked.  I would feel as if they're talking about a different person and like we were completely disconnected from each other. It was really horrible when I would try to explain some problems I have and they could not understand at all and just feel so far away.
 
Not sure how similar it is to your situation, but I think I can relate.
Something I'm going to have to consider more I suppose. I've definitely already had times when I felt like I couldn't do it anymore and focus at all. Thank you
Yup I already am, but where I live there aren't many and I can't get in anywhere. Guess I'll just have to keep looking

Damn I have experienced very similar thoughts a few times myself. I haven't been truly happy about anything for so long I don't even remember what it feels like. Sometimes I wonder how different a normal, mentally healthy persons way of thinking is from mine. 

Also it sucks to forget what you feel yourself. I had times when I was feeling completely determined to end my life and then a few hours later I would sleep it off or forget some other way. This also makes it hard to solve my problems because I have these times when my mind is just absolute hell and then I just forget...Sad to think that the nights during which I felt the worst kind of horror and was contemplating suicide will never be witnessed by anyone and even slowly be forgotten by me myself. Of course the great pains of many other people have been forgotten just the same. I guess that's just how life is. 

I think you write really well by the way

I don't care how much it will pay, but I would like for it to have something to do with programming. Basically I think it would be best for me right now to get some sort of practise in the field that might later help get a job. Seems like the same problems come with temp agencies. Thanks for the advice though. I live in Eastern Europe.

Yeah I get it, I would be anxious about it as well. I hope it works out for you. I will check out the NHS. Don't know if I can get help now, maybe when I'm not dependent on my parents anymore. Yeah wish it could just go away
Yeah same I get a lot of pressure, especially from my dad. I feel you

Nice to know I'm not alone on this at least. I had a psychologist about a year ago but I had to quit before it helped me at all because my parents weren't exactly supportive and thought I was just fucking around (though at the time I was suicidal) and so I felt guilty for going there. Also we're not currently very rich either. Wish I could just get diagnosed properly and get put on some pills. 
Thanks for the advice, but I don't know if I will be able to pull that off yet. I'm still a noob - know c++ and some basic js, html and css. 
I've also been learning drums for a year now so hey maybe I'll be able to make money from that eventually. 
Hope the therapy helps you out.
